questions.question: Choose the correct plural form of child.

solution_steps.text: Child has an irregular plural, so simply adding s is incorrect.
The correct plural is children. Choose B.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The students ___ ready for the lesson.

solution_steps.text: A plural subject needs a matching finite verb. In the present tense, use are.
The complete sentence is: The students are ready for the lesson. Choose C.
